use_cases: Display reading progress on long-form content like articles or documentation
Show page scroll position as a visual indicator for users navigating single-page applications
Indicate download or loading progress when combined with scroll-triggered content
Visual feedback for scroll-based navigation in web apps
ai_summary: A lightweight scroll progress indicator component that renders an animated horizontal bar tracking the user's scroll position. Built with Framer Motion's useScroll and useSpring hooks, it provides smooth spring-based animation with customizable styling and animation options. Supports both page-level and container-scoped scroll tracking.
